_note: The clip plan: which verbatim reference becomes which topic's video, and therefore what a cloud render produces. Edit this file to change the set; the workflow reads it and nothing else. REFERENCES ONLY — no sacred text, no translation and no commentary is ever stored here.

_fields.slug: filename stem of the output; must equal the reference with ':' replaced by '-'
_fields.ref: source:locator, exactly as islamic/sources.py parses it
_fields.topic: must be a key in islamic/topics.py (it selects the headline and the motif)
